results.q: what does the label say about use in pregnancy?
results.shownText: [BW] Boxed warning: when pregnancy is detected, discontinue lisinopril as soon as possible; drugs acting directly on the renin-angiotensin system can injure or kill the developing fetus. · [8.1] Lisinopril can cause fetal harm when administered to a pregnant woman. · [8.1] Second- and third-trimester exposure to drugs acting on the renin-angiotensin system reduces fetal renal function and increases fetal and neonatal morbidity and death. · [8.1] The label identifies oligohydramnios-related fetal and neonatal risks, including renal failure, lung hypoplasia, skeletal deformations, hypotension, and death.
